entities.summary: Pere Coromines i Montanya was a performers & entertainers in Barcelona (1870-05-06, Barcelona – 1939-11-30) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
